summary: Comprehensive testing of PetTracker competitor monitoring tool completed. Backend APIs fully functional (15/15 tests passed). Frontend UI and navigation working correctly with minor modal interaction issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay prevents save button click - requires force=True to interact
ui_bugs.workaround: Dialog can be cancelled and form validation works correctly

Products by Category and Products by Competitor sections display correctly
All 5 sidebar navigation links work (Overview, Competitors, Products, Best Sellers, Price Compare)
Competitors page shows 5 seeded competitors (Zarafa, Petsy, Aleef, Lanapets, Petshouses)
Edit Competitor dialog pre-fills data correctly
Individual sync and Sync All buttons work
Products page loads with 110 products across all categories
Product filters work: category, competitor, stock status, search
Product table sorting works for Price and Rating columns
Best Sellers page shows ranked products (20 found)
Price Comparison page shows matrix with 35 products
Price Comparison highlights lowest prices and shows spreads
All backend APIs return correct status codes and data structures
